player_prompt.intro:
Ko a yi Jokkere {player_id} e Connect Four.
Simboolu maɗaaku maa: {symbol}.
Tapkili ɗemngal ngal e dow {num_rows} e {num_cols} kolamu.
Jokkere ɓesngu ɓaawo ɓaawo ndaɗɗa maɗaaku maa e kolamu ɗe goɗɗe (0 haa {end_col}).
Jo aranɗe tawi ɗo'orɗe (maɗaaku maa) nayi maɗaaku nayi e dow, e leydi, walla e caɗeeɗe.
E dowru maa, enta kolamu numuru e kooseeji ɓaawo e kuɓa maa.
Misalu: '[col 4]' walla '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Dabare fijirde footay yi'eeki ngam ɓe ɗon naati.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Joktii mum formatu e jaa. Formatu e Hakkila: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ɗan {player_id}, Ayyuka bani. Column {col} woni fuɗɗam.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Joktii mum e jaa. Golle {col} e jemma.

outcome.win: Jaawal {player_id} heɓan jahol to o hawti nayi!
